prompt:
A pixel-perfect UI design mockup of a MOBILE APP SCREEN, portrait phone viewport, rendered flat-on as a screen capture. Real app furniture: a nav, a scrollable list, tappable controls.

App: "rootstock", a yard task planner. VISUAL WORLD: a gridded modernist type specimen where the construction grid stays visible as part of the design. Ground is pure white #FFFFFF carrying a faint pale blue construction grid #C8D4F5 of small squares across the ENTIRE screen, clearly visible but quiet. Near-black #111111 type. ONE saturated blue #1B4DF5 as the single accent. Every element snaps exactly to whole grid cells. No rounded corners, no shadows, no cards.

THIS VARIATION: there is NO large display numeral. The count is carried instead by a TALLY BAND built from the grid, and the rows are DENSER so more of the week is visible at once.

LAYOUT top to bottom:
1. Slim app bar snapped to grid: "ROOTSTOCK" in small black condensed caps at left; at right a small one-cell square grid-toggle control filled blue with "GRID" in tiny white caps.
2. Nav row, cell-aligned: "PLAN" with a blue cell-width underline beneath it, then "YARD", "RULES" in black condensed caps.
3. THE TALLY BAND: a full-width horizontal strip exactly two grid cells tall, divided into a row of equal square cells with hairline black borders. The first cell is FILLED SOLID BLUE (recorded); the next two are empty white with black outlines (open); the remaining cells to the right of them are faint pale blue with no outline (nothing scheduled). Beneath the band, small black condensed caps at left: "3 JOBS / 1 RECORDED / 2 OPEN" and at right in grey: "SW FORT WORTH / ZONE 8b / 15 SEP 2026".
4. A black hairline rule exactly on a grid line. Then three DENSE task rows, each only as tall as its content needs, separated by single hairlines on grid lines:
ROW 1: one-cell square checkbox at the left edge, FILLED SOLID BLUE with a white check. Then "FALL PRE-EMERGENT" in bold condensed black caps; on the same line at the right, in small grey caps, "FRONT LAWN". On the next cell line, in a small neutral grotesk: "Apply fall pre-emergent to the front lawn, then irrigate it in according to the product label." On the cell line below that, in small blue mono: "WINDOW / SEP 15 2026".
ROW 2: empty one-cell square checkbox, black outline. "LAST NITROGEN OF THE YEAR" / right "FRONT LAWN" / "Apply the final nitrogen feeding of the year to the front lawn." / blue mono "WINDOW / SEP 15 2026".
ROW 3: empty checkbox. "FEED THE ESPERANZA" / right "ESPERANZA" / "Feed the Esperanza container." / blue mono "NO OCCURRENCE RECORDED".
5. Below the last row, a hairline and then a quiet block in small grotesque: a heading in grey caps "NOT THIS WEEK" and beneath it, in very light grey condensed caps on the grid, a wrapped list of rule names that did not fire: "OVERSEED · AERATION · PRUNE · MULCH · WEED CONTROL · CLEAN BEDS".
6. Footer snapped to grid: "ARTIFACT 4H OLD" in grey caps at left, "2 OPEN" in blue at right.

TYPOGRAPHY: small neutral grotesk for body, bold condensed caps for job names, blue mono with tabular figures for evidence. Construction grid visible behind everything.

Extremely high craft, absolute grid discipline, dense real information, sharp and legible. No shadows, no rounded corners, no plants, no illustration.
note: Superseded. The Visible Grid world it belongs to was built, reviewed and replaced by the Job Ticket; kept because the build history references it.
